title: Bunte Blätter - No. 4
notable_excerpt: Key: A major. Chord journey: vi - IV7 - vi64 drifts through II#6/4 and an I - iii6 alternation, V+7 pivot back to vi, closes vi - IV7 - vi64 - vi. Texture: singing melody over block chords with a steady inner-voice pulse.
video_use_ideas: Sketch material for a film-score cue: take the opening bars and re-orchestrate.
legal_notes: Composer died 1856 (PD). OCR draft: optical music recognition (Audiveris 5.11) of the public-domain scan IMSLP #277060 (Clara Schumann ed., Breitkopf & Härtel 1885), corrected against the page images by an AI model (see tools/omr REPORT). Bar count matches the scan, 0 wrong-length bars, model self-estimate rhythm ~99%, pitch ~96% (an independent spot check of a GPT-6.1 Sol piece found pitch ~85% against a claimed 98%, so treat pitch claims as optimistic). MAY CONTAIN WRONG NOTES. Slurs, pedal and most ornaments not encoded. Transcription released CC0. MusicXML: files/scores/schumann_op99_bunte_blaetter_4.musicxml. Fills complete-set gap: Schumann Bunte Blätter Op. 99.
licence_meaning: PD / CC0 / PDM / US-gov recording and score. Commercial use, no credit needed (courtesy credit still listed where the source asks).
